Card Q&A.a: Yes, if a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself blue, the effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself blue, does this card’s inherited effect activate?

Effect: When this card would be played from the hand, if you have a blue Digimon, reduce the play cost by 1.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have a blue Digimon, ＜Draw 1＞.
